b4_handoff_notes.structural_is_not_technical: A thin structural stroke is NOT technical ink. Keep two sets: (A) structural-geometry evidence — thin strokes, dashed strokes, panel contours, shared edges, folds, glue-flap topology; (B) technical-colour evidence — directly associated spot/registration inks, high-confidence technical-colour candidates, ambiguous RGB-to-spot matches. A stroke may belong to one set, both, or neither. Never exclude a colour from artwork intelligence merely because its path is thin.
b4_handoff_notes.registration_black_ambiguity: Path-level spot association is UNAVAILABLE on this pilot, so an RGB-converted black path must never be mapped to /Separation /All as a fact. Allow multiple candidate explanations, record delta-E to every plausible spot/process black, mark ambiguity, cap confidence, and place unresolved cases in `unresolved_or_ambiguous`. Document-level /All presence must not automatically remove ordinary black artwork from the artwork palette.
